sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, sitting comfortably atop the First Division South with 22 points from 10 games and an impressive recent run of five consecutive wins capped by their most recent victory, host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Alsager are struggling near the foot of the table with just 4 points from 10 games and arrive on the back of a difficult sequence of five consecutive losses, making them an opponent Sandbach will be heavily favoured against.
divisionWide: Several fixtures carry significance for the title race and mid-table positioning. Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town, a mid-table side looking to climb after recent mixed form. AFC Bridgnorth, third and unbeaten in their last five, visit struggling Eccleshall (sixth but on an inconsistent run with a recent loss). Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth and in strong form, host Wednesfield Community. Bilston Town (sixth) face Foley Meir in what could be a mid-table tussle. Barnton entertain Shawbury United, with both sides showing patchy recent records. Market Drayton Town's poor form continues against New Mills, who themselves have lost their last two. Brereton Social (winless in three of their last five games) host Widnes Town, who remain pointless after seven matches. Finally, Crewe travel to face Cheadle Heath Nomads in a clash between two struggling sides at the lower end of the division.
